messages:
Jordan: Hey team — opened a PR to refresh the Python quickstart and add an examples folder. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123. Can someone take a quick look at the streaming snippet and the auth note? aiming to merge today if no blockers :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ava: @Jordan I can take the streaming snippet now. If I tweak the code block I'll ping for a re-run of sample tests :eyes:

Sam: Quick heads-up — please bump the SDK import/version in the snippet to 0.9.2 (client init changed).

Jordan: Good call, I bumped it in the PR (thanks @Sam).

docs-bot: Automated check — docs lint passed. Sample-run queued (/run-samples).

Olivia: One quick note on the auth section: it still mentions the legacy token flow. Recommend swapping to the KMS-backed example and a link to the KMS guide. I'll paste suggested wording in a comment.

Ava: Reviewed the streaming flow. Small nit: show a non-streaming minimal example first, then the streaming variant so new users don't get overwhelmed. Also replaced `stream=True` example with both variants.

Jordan: Added both variants and a short paragraph explaining when to pick streaming vs non-streaming. Also added Olivia's KMS wording.

Sam: Approved. :thumbsup: I'll merge once samples come back green.

docs-bot: Sample tests passed ✅ — all example scripts ran in 2.3s.

Jordan: Merged — thanks everyone for the quick turn on this!
